videos.title: The End of the Static Screen: Architecting Intent-Driven UX — Gus Iwanaga, commercetools
videos.summary: For decades, software forced humans to memorize complex interfaces, but generative UI is finally flipping the script so interfaces dynamically build themselves around human intent. In this talk, Gus from commercetools reveals the hard-won architecture lessons behind building real-world generative UX, moving beyond unreliable open-ended outputs to robust, declarative design systems. Watch this to discover how agentic orchestration and atomic UI design will redefine how users interact with software forever.
